fusions.name: Long Road
fusions.desc: Hurls a bolt that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring its armour. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Heel Nick
fusions.desc: A cut that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 25% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds. Anything struck moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Quiet Tread
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds and you move 25% faster while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Long Stride
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
